method: Direct view_image inspection of all5 PNGs; desktop pair was viewed from run-02 and verified byte-identical to final run-03, remaining3 from run-03.

images.observation: Baseline shows separated efficiency, duration, seconds and budget controls. Snapshot establishes the earlier visual state at the same default values.
Current setup forms a clearly named fieldset with balanced two-column controls; enlarged values and seconds create a useful hierarchy. Keyboard focus is visible; scope remains below without clipping.
At320px all four controls stack in reading order. Light text, numeric values, field boundaries, focus outline and amber time accent remain readable; ranges and scope wrap cleanly.
At320px forced colors preserve fieldset and input boundaries, black time accent and distinct keyboard focus. All labels, range guidance and scope remain visible.
With setup and scope text enlarged to200%, labels and legend wrap, controls grow, and seconds remain readable. The long single-column region has no horizontal clipping or overlapping text.

limits: Focused setup/header/scope review, not a whole-app visual audit.
The200% text case injects doubled computed font sizes into the reviewed setup, summary and scope; it is not browser zoom.

Failed native run-01 was a git-show buffer limit before scenarios. Failed run-02 was a QA locator for a null-valued React data attribute. Both originals, corrections and receipts are preserved; no production changes followed either failure.
Empty stderr log artifacts in run-02 and run-03 were normalized from the wrapper-added newline to zero bytes; native stderr was empty.
